name: Dimbula Orange Pekoe
about: A celebrated classic Ceylon black tea picked during the cool dry months in Dimbula. When infused, it produces a clear reddish-amber cup with a crisp, refreshing bite and subtle notes of lemon zest and wildflowers.
short_desc: Crisp high-grown classic with bright citrus and floral tones.

name: Dimbula Broken Pekoe
about: A robust broken grade from the high valleys of Dimbula. The smaller leaf particle yields an energetic, rapid extraction that shines with milk or honey, releasing notes of toasted malt and warm spices.
short_desc: Brisk broken-leaf tea with golden strength and malty depth.

name: Dimbula Green Leaf
about: Pan-fired Ceylon green tea grown in crisp highland air. Unoxidised leaves offer a pure emerald infusion with subtle grassy sweetness, smooth vegetal undertones, and a gentle mineral finish.
short_desc: Pan-fired highland green tea with sweet grassy nuances.

name: Dimbula Silver Tips
about: Exclusively plucked unopened apical buds from select high-elevation cultivars in Dimbula. Sun-dried with utmost care to produce velvety, silver needle leaves that steep into a pale champagne nectar.
short_desc: Rare hand-plucked silver buds with honeydew and jasmine aromas.

name: Nuwara Eliya Pekoe
about: Hailed as the champagne of Ceylon teas, this whole-leaf pekoe thrives over 6,000 feet amid mist and eucalyptus trees. It brews a luminous pale golden infusion with fragrant notes of wild rose and light peach.
short_desc: Misty highland champagne tea with fragrant floral bouquets.

name: Ceylon Silver Tips
about: The crown jewel of Sri Lankan tea artisans. Only the tender downy buds of Camellia sinensis are harvested at dawn by master pluckers. An extraordinarily pure brew with sweet peach and honey undertones.
short_desc: The pinnacle of Ceylon tea, pure downy velvet white buds.

name: Kandy Green Leaf
about: Artisanal steamed green tea crafted in the verdant middle hills around the historic kingdom of Kandy. Provides a balanced, grounding infusion with roasted nut tones, light astringency, and digestive harmony.
short_desc: Balanced mid-grown green tea with roasted nutty tones.

name: Nuwara Eliya Flowery BOP
about: Containing golden tips intertwined with broken leaves from Nuwara Eliya estates. Produces an invigorating bright cup infused with mountain pine breeze and gentle floral notes.
short_desc: Tip-rich broken grade with pine and blossom aromatics.

name: Nuwara Eliya Imperial White
about: Naturally withered two leaves and a bud, dried purely under gentle highland sunlight. Extremely low in tannins, yielding a smooth, buttery texture with soft melon nuances.
short_desc: Sun-withered high-altitude white tea with silky sweetness.

name: Uva Highland Orange Pekoe
about: Renowned across the globe for its distinct Cachar quality season flavor. Swept by arid winds between July and September, the tea bush develops an intense natural menthol aroma and bold dry finish.
short_desc: Famous eastern slope tea featuring exotic natural menthol.

name: Uva Emerald Green
about: A rare high-grown Ceylon green crafted during the dry Uva wind season. Its lively character combines light spearmint notes with mineral-rich undertones.
short_desc: High-grown green tea infused with crisp mountain herbal aroma.

name: Uva Sunrise Silver Tips
about: Handcrafted in limited batches on eastern ridges in Bandarawela. Dried under morning sun, delivering a crystal-clear brew with hints of honeysuckle and wild mountain herbs.
short_desc: Eastern slope silver buds highlighting crisp honeysuckle.

name: Kandy Royal Flowery BOP
about: Grown in the central river valleys near Kandy. Produces a deep reddish liquor with thick mouthfeel, rich caramelised maltiness, and hints of clove.
short_desc: Rich, comforting mid-grown black tea ideal with breakfast.

name: Kandy Valley White Peony
about: Comprising one silver bud accompanied by two tender leaves. Offers a fuller body than pure silver tips, featuring aromas of sun-cured sweet hay and dried apricots.
short_desc: Mid-elevation white tea blending floral notes with stone fruit.

name: Ruhuna Super Pekoe
about: Born near the tropical southern coast under rich sub-tropical sun. The leaves roll into twisted ebony wires, brewing a thick, syrupy dark liquor full of dark cocoa and molasses richness.
short_desc: Bold low-grown black tea overflowing with dark caramel and cocoa.

name: Ruhuna Golden White Tips
about: Grown close to the Indian ocean breeze where high humidity prompts lush leaf growth. Plucked with untouched purity, giving a nectar-like golden-white liquor packed with wild honey aroma.
short_desc: Tropical coastal white tea steeped in liquid honey sweetness.

name: Ruhuna Rainforest Green
about: Harvested from smallholder tea gardens fringing the Sinharaja rainforest. Features deeply satisfying sweet bamboo aromatics with a rounded, smooth mouthfeel.
short_desc: Rainforest-border low-grown green tea with rich toasted sweetness.

name: Sabaragamuwa Orange Pekoe
about: Cultivated in the gem-rich valleys surrounding Ratnapura. The distinctive low-elevation soil gives this tea a captivating copper brew with distinct notes of ripe plum and date syrup.
short_desc: Rich, sweet southern valley tea with notes of dark plum and honey.

name: Sabaragamuwa Silver Needle
about: Selected from fast-growing, mineral-fed lowland bushes. The buds produce a silky liquor marked by unexpected notes of warm Madagascar vanilla and honeydew melon.
short_desc: Lowland silver tips showcasing velvety mouthfeel and vanilla notes.

name: Sabaragamuwa Golden Needle White
about: Speciality white tea crafted using delicate pan-drying techniques. The liquor glows soft amber-gold, imparting flavours of dried Calimyrna figs and gentle aromatic spices.
short_desc: Mellow lowland white tea with dried fig and warm spice undertones.

name: Dimbula Golden Valley Pekoe
about: From the western hills of Bogawantalawa (the Golden Valley). Characterised by exceptional colour and brightness with a brisk, invigorating aroma.
short_desc: Golden Valley pekoe showcasing brisk floral malt character.
